chunks: Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners) (scheme_TN09) is administered by Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. It is available in Tamil Nadu. Official website: https://treasuries.tn.gov.in/. Summary: Health insurance for Tamil Nadu government pensioners, family pensioners and eligible dependents, with basic sum insured of ₹7.50 lakh and up to ₹12 lakh for specified illnesses, effective July 2026 for a five-year block.

Coverage under Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; no Corpus Fund for pensioners. Cashless treatment is available at empanelled hospitals.

Eligibility criteria for Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): Income limit: N/A; based on pension status. BPL/SECC required: No. Age group: Pensioners and eligible dependents. Target beneficiaries: State civil, teacher, All India Service and other eligible pensioners and family pensioners drawing pension from Tamil Nadu Consolidated Fund.

Required documents for Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): Pension Payment Order (PPO) number; Pension disbursing office and bank details; Identity and age proofs; Photographs and dependency proofs as per enrollment form. All documents must be valid and original or attested copies as per official guidelines.

Conditions and treatments covered under Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): Hospitalization and day-care procedures under approved packages; Specified illness procedures (46 listed); Treatments under 2,992 approved procedures; Super-speciality and critical care at empanelled hospitals. Treatment must be at an empanelled or government hospital for cashless benefit.

Exclusions and procedures NOT covered under Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): Outpatient (OPD) treatment; AYUSH treatments; Non-package and non-empanelled treatment outside rules; HIV/AIDS-related expenses as per guidelines. Patients should verify specific exclusions with the scheme authority before treatment.

How to apply for Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): Visit the official portal at https://treasuries.tn.gov.in/ or contact the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), district hospital, or Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu office. Carry all required documents including identity proof and income/category certificates.

Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners) is a Tamil Nadu state-specific scheme. Only residents of Tamil Nadu with a valid family ration card or state domicile certificate are eligible. Non-Tamil Nadu residents should check PM-JAY or their own state's equivalent health scheme.

Key facts about Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners): Department: Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. State: Tamil Nadu. Coverage: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; no Corpus Fund for pensioners. Cashless: Yes. Age group: Pensioners and eligible dependents. Income ceiling: N/A; based on pension status.
